about: Projects and catalogues that collect sources, so we stop searching for them one at a time. Each is checked when sources.json is reviewed; a source found through one records it in found_via.

hubs.name: God's Eye View
hubs.what: CesiumJS globe of live public data: flights, ships, satellites, quakes, fires, cameras, transit, weather. Has an MCP server and a layer/provider registry.
hubs.license: MIT code; bundled data under its own terms (some CC BY-NC-SA)
hubs.relationship: Layer provider target: open-signals layers as a God's Eye View provider.

hubs.name: World Monitor
hubs.what: Global intelligence dashboard over 500+ feeds (conflict, markets, chokepoints, outages, disasters); serves its data over MCP, REST, SDKs and a CLI.
hubs.relationship: Feed list to mine; possible adapter target.

hubs.name: OSIRIS
hubs.what: Next.js + MapLibre OSINT dashboard: flights, satellites, cameras, quakes, fires, conflict, news.
hubs.license: reported MIT; not verified against the original repository

hubs.name: WorldWideView
hubs.what: Cesium globe with a plugin marketplace for data layers.
hubs.relationship: Watch only until the licence is confirmed.

hubs.name: Shadowbroker
hubs.what: Community OSINT globe built on the God's Eye View recipe.
hubs.found_via: Bilawal Sidhu, 'Intelligence Agencies Spent Billions on This. Now It's Open Source.' (2026-10-25)

hubs.name: ULTOR
hubs.what: Community OSINT fusion globe from the same recipe.

hubs.name: Gemini / Claude Earth
hubs.what: Browser globe of public layers built with coding agents.

hubs.name: Official MCP Registry
hubs.what: Open catalogue and API of public MCP servers.
hubs.relationship: Where open-signals' MCP server gets listed.

hubs.name: awesome-mcp-servers, Location section
hubs.what: Community list; its location/mapping section holds gis-mcp, geoserver-mcp, MCP-Geo and the Overture servers.
hubs.relationship: Listing target; source of geospatial MCP servers.

hubs.name: Source Cooperative
hubs.what: Repository of open geospatial datasets from 90+ organisations (Maxar, ESA, USGS, Harvard, ...).
hubs.relationship: Bulk datasets; a community MCP server exists (yharby/source-coop-mcp).

hubs.name: Registry of Open Data on AWS
hubs.what: Catalogue of public datasets hosted on AWS (NOAA GFS, Sentinel, Landsat, ...).

hubs.name: Data.gov
hubs.relationship: US government sources; a community MCP server exists.

hubs.name: public-apis
hubs.what: Community list of free APIs by category.
hubs.relationship: Breadth check when a topic has no source yet.
